import sys


def main():
    values = [int(x) for x in sys.stdin.read().split()]
    n = len(values)

    if n == 0:
        print("count 0")
        return

    print("count", n)

    total = sum(values)
    mean = total / n
    mean_str = "{:.2f}".format(round(mean, 2))
    print("mean", mean_str)

    s = sorted(values)
    if n % 2 == 1:
        print("median", s[n // 2])
    else:
        mid1 = s[n // 2 - 1]
        mid2 = s[n // 2]
        median = (mid1 + mid2) / 2
        print("median", f"{median:.1f}")

    counts = {}
    for v in values:
        counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
    mode_val = max(counts, key=lambda k: counts[k])
    print("mode", mode_val)

    print("range", max(values) - min(values))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
